description: Four clock dividers and multipliers in one, each with its own division, pulse width and second output, all fed by one clock or by four

params.text: Tap it twice to set the tempo of the module's own clock, which feeds any channel with nothing in its CLK IN
An attenuverter on that channel's GATE PW jack, setting how much the voltage moves the pulse width; it does nothing while that jack is empty
Sets the width of that channel's output gate as a share of its own period, with 5ms kept clear at each end
Sets what that channel's INV OUT carries: TRIG a trigger at the end of the gate, so the gate width becomes a delay, INVGATE the output turned upside down, DOUBLE a trigger on both edges
An attenuverter on that channel's DIV/MULT jack, setting how much the voltage moves the division; it does nothing while that jack is empty
Sets that channel's division or multiplication of the clock, in nineteen steps from a thirty-second of it up to sixteen times it

inputs.text: Moves that channel's pulse width, through the attenuverter knob beside it, 10V covering the whole range
Moves that channel's division, through the attenuverter knob beside it, 10V covering the whole range
The clock this channel divides or multiplies; it also feeds every channel below it that has nothing in its own CLK IN
A rising edge above 2V clears that channel's count and its measured period, so the channel starts again from the next clock

outputs.text: A 10V gate at the tempo of the module's own clock, half the period high
That channel's second output: a trigger, an inverted gate, or a trigger on both edges, whichever the channel's three-way switch is set to; 5V either way
That channel's divided or multiplied clock, a 5V gate of the width set by GATE PW

notes: With no CLK IN patched, all four channels run from the tap clock. A cable in CLK IN 1 takes over all four, one in CLK IN 2 takes over channels 2 to 4, and so on down.
The two small attenuverter knobs on a channel are read only while their own jack is patched, so turning one with an empty jack changes nothing.
